name: Threads
role: Primary. Where it is popping off. Text-first, conversational, fast replies win.
format: Text up to 500 chars, 1-10 images, or short video. Lead with a line that stands alone. Post the image, say one true thing about it, ask one question.
rules: Reply to every comment within the first 30 minutes. That window decides reach.
One idea per post. Save the rest for the next slot.
Repost your own best post from 30+ days ago once a week with a new first line.

name: Instagram
role: The portfolio and the storefront window. Collectors check it before they buy.
format: Feed 4:5 (1080x1350). Reels 9:16 up to 90s, hook in the first second, captions on. Stories daily, 15s max each, raw is fine.
rules: Feed grid is for finished work and the strongest process shots only.
Stories are where the mess goes: WIP, studio, packing orders, polls.
Pin the current drop or print shop post to the top of the grid.

name: TikTok
role: Discovery engine for process video. Pure reach, no followers needed.
format: 9:16 vertical, 15-60s. First frame is the most interesting moment of the painting, not a logo. Voiceover or on-screen text telling what you were thinking.
rules: Same video goes to Reels and YouTube Shorts. Record once, post three times.
Satisfying strokes, big brush moments, the reveal pull-back.

name: Pinterest
role: Evergreen search traffic to the print shop. Slow but compounding.
format: One batch of 5 pins. 2:3 vertical (1000x1500). Title with searchable words (oil painting, figure study, living room art). Link every pin to the shop or site.
rules: Batch it: one sitting a week, 5 pins, done.
Pin finished work, prints in rooms, and process stills.

name: Email list
role: The only audience you own. Drops go to email first, socials second.
format: Short. One image, one story, one link. Subject line under 6 words.
rules: Every drop: email 24 hours before the public announcement.
Every post that performs: mention the list exists.

name: Shop / prints
role: Where the money lands. Listings, prints, originals, shipping.
format: Clean photo on white or in a room, title, size, medium, price, shipping. Prints: sizes and edition info.
rules: Every finished piece gets a listing or a 'sold' label within a week.
Ship within 2 business days, post a photo of the packed order to Stories.

name: YouTube
role: Optional. Shorts from the same process footage. Turn on when TikTok is steady.
format: Shorts 9:16 under 60s. Same files as TikTok.
